headline: The waterfall plays like the cabinet: scripted finale + vine carriers
lede: CONTRA's two oldest honest gaps shipped in one stage: the dying gate now blows at fixed, choreographed sites — guns first, the heart last, identical on every seed — and four hanging vines carry a hero who reaches for them, flinging the climb up a line the shelves never offered.

notes.text: The cascade is SCRIPTED: 14 blast sites walked position-by-position with zero rng — the same fire choreography byte-for-byte on every seed (cross-seed pins prove the rng stays untouched through the whole countdown).

Vine carriers: airborne + jump held catches a swinging tip; the arc flings the rider at least 20 px above the catch, jump releases early with the momentum. Blue seat rides the same load-bearing code; the torrent still takes a low rider.
contracheck 147 -> 161/161 (11 new pins, 4 live browser legs incl. pixel baselines and a real-keys STAGE CLEAR); mutants 22/22 named, including cascade-random, vine-deadwood and vine-sink.
Harness lesson: drown/contact deaths ignore invulnerability — long browser legs at the rising torrent need lives, and a held jump key re-grabs the vine, so releases ride one-tick taps.
